prompt: The client wants to acquire a target that is both growing fast and profitable. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Company B earns the best margin, 20%
options.feedback: True, but B grows only 5% a year. The client wants growth and profit together.

options.text: C combines the most revenue with solid growth
options.feedback: C is the largest, but it grows only 2% a year with a 12% margin.

options.text: A pairs 25% growth with an 18% margin
options.feedback: Right. A grows 25% a year at an 18% margin; B grows 5% and C grows 2% with a 12% margin.

options.text: A's management team is the strongest
options.feedback: The table shows financials, not management. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

explanation: A grows 25% a year at an 18% margin; B grows 5% and C grows 2% with a 12% margin.

extras.proof: A grows 25% a year at an 18% margin; B grows 5% and C grows 2% with a 12% margin.
